description: P1 retirement scrub (FR-013). The CI test-selection basis (dorny filter groups + --cov targets) re-derived against the LIVE post-#3921 src/** tree. The WP02 census oracle (tests/architectural/_p1_census_oracle.py) is the authority: no kept group maps a filter group or a --cov target onto a retired subsystem (sync/saas/delivery/event_journal/egress/websockets) or any census-dead surface, and every excluded surface cites the oracle's independent evidence. This is the single data source WP07 (router groups) and WP08 (module registry / shard-freeze) consume -- they derive from it, they do not re-scrub. It lands BEFORE the --durations shard-freeze so shard boundaries are measured on the scrubbed live basis. Enforced by tests/architectural/test_retirement_scrub.py.
notes: Coverage form (C-005): --cov targets are kept in dotted module form (never path form) and pyproject [tool.coverage.run].relative_files=true is preserved -- both are required for multi-<source> coverage resolution by the downstream aggregators.

Re-derivation (moves, NOT census exclusions): the historical standalone 'doctrine' group (src/doctrine/**) and the --cov=doctrine.missions target were re-mapped to their live successor src/charter/offering/** (doctrine absorbed into charter/offering post-convergence); doctrine is a MOVE, not a retirement, so it is not in excluded_surfaces. The stale core_misc root src/specify_cli/render/** was dropped -- the render package no longer exists (oracle: importer-count:0), so it is not carried by any kept group.

The enforcement allowlists (test_no_dead_symbols / test_no_dead_modules / test_no_retired_subsystems) that QUOTE dead surfaces as banned strings are out of scope of exclusion (C-006): they stay always-on blocking gates and never appear in excluded_surfaces.

Test-inventory groups (mission sonar-per-pr-coverage-reuse-01M2FR32, WP02): `unit` and `specify_cli_runtime` are rows for live test directories that had no declared home. Their roots are deliberately a SUBSET of globs other kept groups already own (never a new src/** claim), so adding them changes no path's group match and leaves the FR-004 fail-closed `unmatched` union semantics intact. Rationale and the rejected alternative are recorded in kitty-specs/sonar-per-pr-coverage-reuse-01M2FR32/traces/design-decisions.md.

groups.note: TEST-INVENTORY row (mission sonar-per-pr-coverage-reuse-01M2FR32, WP02/FR-006). This group exists to give a live test directory a declared home in the module registry so retiring the duplicate broad-measurement step does not remove its PER-CHANGE execution. It owns no src/** surface of its own: every root below is a VERBATIM copy of a glob another kept group already owns, so the router's path->group mapping and the FR-004 fail-closed `unmatched` union are unchanged (no path gains or loses a match). Roots/cov_targets are the subset of already-owned surfaces the directory's tests actually import -- never a surface no other group claims, which would silently narrow an unmapped src/** change away from the run-all catch-all. Covers tests/unit (already the first directory of the CLAUDE.md fast tier).
